oneAtATime: Deploys are listed one environment at a time.
repositoryNote: Lists the repositories deployed in {{environment}} now and those whose deploys this list has shown.
currentFailed: The current versions could not be read, so no deploy is marked current and none offers a rollback: {{sentence}}
failedWithout: The deploy failed without saying why.

dialog.title: Roll back {{repository}} in {{environment}}?
dialog.text: This makes {{commit}}, deployed {{when}} by {{who}}, the current version of {{repository}} in {{environment}} again. Every job {{repository}} defines there changes with it:
dialog.noJobs: {{repository}} defines no job in either version.
dialog.noTargetJobs: The server did not say which jobs that version defines, so the rollback is not offered here. Close this and open it again; if it stays so, ask the operator to check the server's version.

note.failedWithout: The rollback failed without saying why.

undeployDialog.title: Undeploy {{repository}} from {{environment}}?
undeployDialog.text: This removes the deployment of {{repository}} from {{environment}}, and with it:
undeployDialog.jobWaiting: {{job}}: removed; its waiting start is dropped
undeployDialog.jobScheduledWaiting: {{job}}: removed, with its schedule; its waiting start is dropped
undeployDialog.runAs: The service account its runs write as, {{account}}: no longer bound
undeployDialog.health: The health effects of its tables: every health signal of these tables warns
undeployDialog.kept: Its tables and their data stay, as orphans, and its deploys stay listed. Deploying it again brings its jobs back.
undeployDialog.keptRunAs: Its tables and their data stay, as orphans, and its deploys stay listed. Deploying it again brings its jobs back, but its scheduled jobs do not run until an administrator binds {{account}} again, with a passkey touch.
undeployDialog.held: Type the repository's name exactly to undeploy it.

undeployNote: Undeployed {{repository}} from {{environment}}. Its tables stay, as orphans.
